youtube_description:
Emptiness in Buddhism is seen as full of potential, because it allows for the fluid, interconnected nature of reality. It is also said to be full of compassion, because it allows us to see the interdependence of all beings and to have empathy for their suffering.

"self luminosity" refers to the idea that consciousness or the true self is innately luminous or radiant. This concept is often associated with the idea that the true self is eternal and unchanging, and that it shines forth in all beings, illuminating their minds and giving rise to their experiences. In this sense, self luminosity is seen as a quality or aspect of the true self, rather than something that the self possesses. It is a way of describing the nature of consciousness or the true self, rather than a characteristic that can be observed or measured.
